incident-bot: ALERT: spike in queue latency + increased 502s on /v1/generate (ap-southeast-1). paging eng-oncall :rotating_light:

ravi (oncall): taking it. looking at traces and request shapes.

emily: p95 up from ~60ms -> ~420ms, p99 ~1.9s. queue depth on batch-router jumped; cpu for router pods high. GPU pools show normal processing time per-token.

tony: appears to be many small requests with long prompt prep causing batching delay; continuous-batcher waiting to reach batch-size instead of flushing quickly for short requests. suspect threshold mis-evaluation after last rollout.

ravi (oncall): we need to reduce waiting for short requests immediately. mitigation plan: (1) lower batch wait window, (2) enable aggressive small-request flush, (3) temporarily apply per-customer token-rate soft caps for top offenders, (4) consider disabling prefix-cache for heavy KV lookups if latency persists.

k8s-bot: No infra deploys in last 20m.

emily: I can hotpatch these runtime params. propose: runtime.continuous.batch_wait_ms 100 -> 15, runtime.continuous.small_request_flush=true, runtime.batch.shape_target=latency. Also toggle `router.request_priority` to prefer small requests.

luis: will prepare quota rules for noisy customers. recommend a soft cap at 160 req/s for 30m and notify CS.

ravi (oncall): go for it. please announce commands when you run them.

emily: applying hot-reload now:

```
# hot-reload runtime
set runtime.continuous.batch_wait_ms=15
set runtime.continuous.small_request_flush=true
set runtime.batch.shape_target=latency
set router.request_priority=small_first
```

emily: rolled to 8/8 router pods in ap-southeast-1 at 2212345638.

incident-bot: CONFIG_UPDATE: runtime.continuous.* changed by emily (propagated to 8 nodes) at 2212345638.

luis: applying soft caps: top-7 noisy keys -> soft_cap=160 req/s duration=30m enforcement=queue-priority. will tag customers for CS.

luis: quota rules active at 2212345650.

customer-success-zoe: pinging affected customers now. will escalate any critical impact.

ravi (oncall): telemetry after 45s: p95 dropped to ~78ms, p99 ~280ms. 502 rate decreased by ~70%. router CPU normalized.

emily: GPU efficiency took a hit ~9%, but safe. cost delta small for 30m window.

ravi (oncall): good. next steps: keep current settings 30m, monitor for any resurgence. if errors pop back up, we consider disabling prefix-cache per-route as a more aggressive mitigation (can add token cost). Also consider adding a graduated batching policy: latency-first for public API, throughput-first for batch endpoint.

eng-mgr-sophia: please capture the change set and open INC-4412 to follow up on batching heuristics and per-customer policy. keep CS looped.

emily: filing INC-4412 now and attaching config snapshot.

incident-bot: ONCALL HANDOFF: ravi (oncall) active until 2212346200; handoff to tony if unresolved.

ravi (oncall): runbook for whoever picks up:
- symptom: queueing/502s due to continuous-batcher waiting for larger aggregations; observed after recent routing tweak.
- immediate mitigation: lowered batch_wait_ms to 15ms, enabled small_request_flush, set batch.shape_target=latency, applied soft caps to top noisy keys at 160 req/s for 30m.
- observed effect: p95 improved from ~420ms -> ~78ms, p99 improved significantly; 502s dropped ~70%. GPU util up ~9%.
- pending items: (A) review logs for keys that hit soft caps and call out heavy customers, (B) evaluate cost impact and decide on graduated policy, (C) add unit tests for batch-shape heuristic to prevent regressions.

tony: ack. I'll monitor the thread and check the soft-cap hit counts every 5m.

customer-success-zoe: one customer reported degraded streaming experience during early mitigation but no functional errors. sending a FYI note.

ravi (oncall): marking thread ongoing; close when stable for 30m without error recurrence. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: THREAD_STATUS: ongoing (mitigations active)
